name: OCR
description: Extract Chinese and English text from images, screenshots and PDFs, fully offline
help: Runs PaddleOCR PP-OCRv4 models in Rust on your machine; files never leave your computer.
Download the two models once (about 15 MB in total). Downloads resume if interrupted, fall back to mirrors and are verified with SHA-256.
Open or drop an image or PDF, or press ⌘/Ctrl+V to recognize a screenshot from the clipboard.
PDFs are recognized page by page, up to 200 pages. The result includes the full text plus each page.
Hover a box to see its text and click it to copy that line. The recognized text can be edited before copying.
